title: curcuma lutea
intro: Curcuma lutea, commonly known as Turmeric, is a plant species belonging to the ginger family (Zingiberaceae). The health benefits of Curcuma lutea include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Curcuma lutea include its ability to modulate the immune system, improve cognitive function, and alleviate symptoms of depression and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Curcuma lutea include curcuminoids, such as curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
